text.p: Daugavpils Chain factory on Friday saw its price drop to 1.17 lats from 2.15 lats as it went ex-bonus on May 30, dealers said.
"We can basically say the price is the same as yesterday only adjusted to the bonus share issue volume," Roberts Idelsons, head of securities department of Trasta Bank, told Reuters.
Some dealers expected the price to rise slightly next week and reach the level of 1.20 lats to 1.25 lats.
Daugavpils Chain, currently in the process of applying for a transfer to the bourse's official list, earlier issued some seven million bonus shares or 84 shares per 100 shares held.
The registration day for these shares is May 30.
The bonus share issue has not yet been registered in the central depository as a public issue which is a condition for the shares actually to hit the market.
